```{python}
#| echo: false
import graphviz
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display
import os
import sys

# Import helper functions
from dih_models.plotting.graphviz_helper import (
    setup_graphviz_style,
    render_graphviz_with_watermark
)
from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import get_project_root

# Get project root using robust path detection
project_root = get_project_root()

# Create diagram
dot = graphviz.Digraph(comment='RAPPA Mechanism Flow', format='png')
dot.attr(rankdir='TB', size='8,12')

# Apply design guide styling
setup_graphviz_style(dot)

# Define Nodes
# Usage: dot.node(name, label, **attrs)

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_inputs') as c:
    c.attr(label='1. Individual Inputs', style='dashed', color='black')
    c.node('Citizens', 'Citizens\n(N Participants)', shape='ellipse')
    c.node('Pairs', 'Randomized Pairs\n(Subset of Comparisons)', shape='box')

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_process') as c:
    c.attr(label='2. RAPPA Aggregation', style='dashed', color='black')
    c.node('Ratios', 'Pairwise Ratios\n(Slider Allocations)', shape='box')
    c.node('GeoMean', 'Geometric Mean\n(Aggregation)', shape='box', penwidth='2')
    c.node('Matrix', 'Aggregate Matrix\n(A)', shape='box')

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_synthesis') as c:
    c.attr(label='3. Synthesis', style='dashed', color='black')
    c.node('Eigen', 'Eigenvector\nMethod', shape='box')
    c.node('Weights', 'Global Priority\nVector (w)', shape='box', penwidth='2')

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_output') as c:
    c.attr(label='4. Output', style='dashed', color='black')
    c.node('Budget', 'Final Budget\nAllocation', shape='doubleoctagon')

# Define Edges
dot.edge('Citizens', 'Pairs', label=' View')
dot.edge('Pairs', 'Ratios', label=' Allocate')
dot.edge('Ratios', 'GeoMean', label=' Aggregate')
dot.edge('GeoMean', 'Matrix', label=' Construct')
dot.edge('Matrix', 'Eigen', label=' Calculate')
dot.edge('Eigen', 'Weights', label=' Derive')
dot.edge('Weights', 'Budget', label=' Map to $')

# Render with watermark and metadata
# This will save to knowledge/figures/rappa-mechanism-flow-diagram.png
output_dir = project_root / 'knowledge' / 'figures'
png_path = render_graphviz_with_watermark(dot, 'rappa-mechanism-flow-diagram', output_dir)

display(IPImage(str(png_path)))
```
